# Playset / 놀이세트 / プレイセット / 游戏套装

> A caregiver picks only the simple brain games they want from a fixed set of six, saves them as an ordered playlist, and presses play — the next game starts by itself. No login, no three-game daily lock, no subscription, and the queue survives a tab close.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://playset.try-dabble.com/
Playlists (name, ordered games, loop flag) and the place in a running queue are stored in this browser only (localStorage keys playset:playlists:v1 and playset:session:v1). No accounts, no subscription, no server-side storage, no sharing.

This is NOT a Lumosity clone and NOT a cognitive assessment. There is no training programme, no daily prescribed set, no score history, no percentile and no leaderboard. It is a play tray: six short tap games, and a queue someone else built for the person holding the phone.

## Pages

- [Home](https://playset.try-dabble.com/): The tray — your saved playlists, and play
- [Privacy](https://playset.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy

- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/playset): How-to on try-dabble.com

## The six games

- Pair matching (짝맞추기) — twelve blocks, six pairs, turn two over
- Sequence memory (순서기억) — four pads light up, tap them back in order
- Find the different one (다른 것 찾기) — nine blocks, one differs in colour or shape
- Easy addition (쉬운 덧셈) — two single digits, three big answers
- Colour & shape sort (색·모양 분류) — one item, two boxes, match colour or shape
- Target tap (목표 탭) — a big circle appears somewhere; tap it

Every game runs 60–90 seconds. Tap targets are deliberately oversized. There are no red fail screens: a wrong tap is a soft peach wobble and the round continues.

## Features

- Build a playlist by tapping games; the same game can be added more than once
- Reorder or remove any step; optional loop back to the first game at the end
- Press play once — each game hands off to the next automatically after a soft pause with a large Next button for anyone who wants to wait
- Save as many playlists as you like; there is no cap
- The place in a running queue is written down every step, so a locked phone or a closed tab comes back to the same game
- No login, no sign-up, no social account, no payment screen
- No three-games-a-day limit and no premium lock: all six games always open
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
